integrity: Two independently written exhaustive subset-search computations agree on all count cells; direct word and symmetry-orbit checks. Unrestricted complete deterministic automata, two labeled letters.
scientific_limitations: Complete enumeration only for all binary ordered automata on five labeled states; no extension to larger automata or other alphabets. No independent external audit. Historical novelty cannot be proved from literature searches.
title: Shortest-reset-word multiplicities of all binary five-state automata
